steps.name: Compute node_modules hash
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail

BUILD_LOG=$(mktemp)
trap 'rm -f "$BUILD_LOG"' EXIT

HASH=""
MAX_ATTEMPTS=3
for ((ATTEMPT = 1; ATTEMPT <= MAX_ATTEMPTS; ATTEMPT++)); do
  # Build with fakeHash to trigger hash mismatch and reveal correct hash
  nix build ".#packages.${SYSTEM}.node_modules_updater" --no-link 2>&1 | tee "$BUILD_LOG" || true

  HASH="$(nix run --inputs-from . nixpkgs#gnugrep -- -oP 'got:\s*\Ksha256-[A-Za-z0-9+/=]+' "$BUILD_LOG" | tail -n1 || true)"

  [ -n "$HASH" ] && break

  if [ "$ATTEMPT" -lt "$MAX_ATTEMPTS" ]; then
    echo "::warning::Attempt ${ATTEMPT}/${MAX_ATTEMPTS} produced no hash for ${SYSTEM}; retrying in $((ATTEMPT * 10))s"
    sleep $((ATTEMPT * 10))
  fi
done

if [ -z "$HASH" ]; then
  echo "::error::Failed to compute hash for ${SYSTEM} after ${MAX_ATTEMPTS} attempts"
  cat "$BUILD_LOG"
  exit 1
fi

echo "$HASH" > hash.txt
echo "Computed hash for ${SYSTEM}: $HASH"

steps.name: Update hashes.json
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail

HASH_FILE="nix/hashes.json"

[ -f "$HASH_FILE" ] || echo '{"nodeModules":{}}' > "$HASH_FILE"

for SYSTEM in x86_64-linux aarch64-linux aarch64-darwin; do
  HASH="$(tr -d '[:space:]' < "$HASHES/hash-${SYSTEM}/hash.txt")"
  echo "${SYSTEM}: ${HASH}"
  jq --arg sys "$SYSTEM" --arg h "$HASH" '.nodeModules[$sys] = $h' "$HASH_FILE" > tmp.json
  mv tmp.json "$HASH_FILE"
done

cat "$HASH_FILE"
bash .github/nix-hashes/validate.sh "$HASH_FILE"

if git diff --quiet -- "$HASH_FILE"; then
  echo "changed=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  echo "### Nix hashes" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
  echo "Status: no changes" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
else
  echo "changed=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  echo "### Nix hashes" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
  echo "Status: changed" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
fi

steps.name: Check branch
steps.run:
if [ "$HEAD_REF" = bot/nix-hashes ]; then
  echo "bot=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
else

steps.name: Check changed files
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
git fetch --no-tags --filter=blob:none origin "+refs/heads/$BASE:refs/remotes/origin/$BASE"
changed=$(git diff --name-only "origin/$BASE...HEAD")
echo "Changed files:"
echo "$changed"
if [ "$changed" != nix/hashes.json ]; then
  echo "::error::bot/nix-hashes may change only nix/hashes.json"
  exit 1
fi

steps.name: Evaluate flake outputs (all systems)
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
nix --version

echo "=== Flake metadata ==="
nix flake metadata

echo ""
echo "=== Flake structure ==="
nix flake show --all-systems

SYSTEMS="x86_64-linux aarch64-linux aarch64-darwin"
PACKAGES="opencode"
# TODO: move 'desktop' to PACKAGES when #11755 is fixed
OPTIONAL_PACKAGES="desktop"

echo ""
echo "=== Evaluating packages for all systems ==="
for system in $SYSTEMS; do
  echo ""
  echo "--- $system ---"
  for pkg in $PACKAGES; do
    printf "  %s: " "$pkg"
    if output=$(nix eval ".#packages.$system.$pkg.drvPath" --raw 2>&1); then
      echo "✓"
    else
      echo "✗"
      echo "::error::Evaluation failed for packages.$system.$pkg"
      echo "$output"
      exit 1
    fi
  done
done

echo ""
echo "=== Evaluating optional packages ==="
for system in $SYSTEMS; do
  echo ""
  echo "--- $system ---"
  for pkg in $OPTIONAL_PACKAGES; do
    printf "  %s: " "$pkg"
    if output=$(nix eval ".#packages.$system.$pkg.drvPath" --raw 2>&1); then
      echo "✓"
    else
      echo "✗"
      echo "::warning::Evaluation failed for packages.$system.$pkg"
      echo "$output"
    fi
  done
done

echo ""
echo "=== Evaluating devShells for all systems ==="
for system in $SYSTEMS; do
  printf "%s: " "$system"
  if output=$(nix eval ".#devShells.$system.default.drvPath" --raw 2>&1); then
    echo "✓"
  else
    echo "✗"
    echo "::error::Evaluation failed for devShells.$system.default"
    echo "$output"
    exit 1
  fi
done

echo ""
echo "=== All evaluations passed ==="

steps.name: Fix Zig 0.16 ARM64 function-pointer alignment
steps.run:
# ARM64 function pointers require 4-byte alignment, unlike *anyopaque.
# Zig 0.16's Windows stack-trace helper omits the required alignment assertion.
$file = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'zig-x86_64-windows-0.16.0/lib/std/debug/SelfInfo/Windows.zig'
$source = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($file)
$old = '@ptrCast(try si.loadNtdllProc(@tagName(proc)))'
if (!$source.Contains($old)) { throw 'Zig alignment workaround no longer matches; re-evaluate it' }
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($file, $source.Replace($old, '@ptrCast(@alignCast(try si.loadNtdllProc(@tagName(proc))))'))

steps.name: Verify runner and compiler architecture
Run standalone library tests
steps.run:
$artifacts = cargo test --locked --lib --no-run --message-format=json | ForEach-Object { $_ | ConvertFrom-Json }
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
$binary = ($artifacts | Where-Object { $_.reason -eq 'compiler-artifact' -and $_.profile.test -and $_.executable }).executable
# Cargo adds native library paths to PATH, which can hide accidental DLL dependencies.
# Copy only the executable so neither Cargo nor adjacent build artifacts can supply them.
$directory = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'pty-standalone-tests'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $directory | Out-Null
$standalone = Join-Path $directory 'opencode-pty-tests.exe'
Copy-Item $binary $standalone
$bytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($standalone)
$header = [BitConverter]::ToInt32($bytes, 0x3c)
$machine = [BitConverter]::ToUInt16($bytes, $header + 4)
if ($machine -ne [Convert]::ToUInt16($env:EXPECTED_MACHINE, 16)) { throw 'Test executable architecture does not match the runner' }
& $standalone

Document current coverage
steps.run:
@"
## Windows ${{ matrix.arch }}

Target: $env:CARGO_BUILD_TARGET

This job builds the executable and runs all enabled tests natively, including libghostty parser, protocol, direct TerminalService ConPTY runtime, named-pipe transport, and daemon tests.
The runtime suite spawns real Rust console children and checks input/output, Unicode, cwd/environment/argv/PATH, OS resize, snapshots, replay, terminal replies, and independent terminals.
Daemon tests cover private atomic registration, ownership/handoff, stale registration/locking, partial requests, blocked subscribers, and live ConPTY operations over real named pipes.
The older service, ownership, playground, and rows integration suites remain Unix-only.
Basic tests do not establish exhaustive lifecycle coverage or Windows interactive CLI parity.
No packages or releases are published.

steps.name: Create checksums and manifest
steps.run:
version="$(node -p 'require("../npm/package.json").version')"
sha256sum opencode-pty-*.tar.gz > SHA256SUMS
artifacts='[]'
while read -r sha256 archive; do
  target="${archive#opencode-pty-${version}-}"
  target="${target%.tar.gz}"
  artifacts="$(jq --arg target "$target" --arg archive "$archive" --arg sha256 "$sha256" '. + [{target: $target, archive: $archive, sha256: $sha256}]' <<<"$artifacts")"
done < SHA256SUMS
jq -n \
  --arg version "$version" \
  --argjson protocol "$PROTOCOL_VERSION" \
  --argjson artifacts "$artifacts" \
  '{schema: 1, version: $version, protocol: $protocol, artifacts: $artifacts}' \
  > release-manifest.json
sha256sum release-manifest.json >> SHA256SUMS
